## Description

R5: `.basedpyright/baseline.json` is tracked in git.
R7: `uv run basedpyright` exits 0 on the repository.
R8: A new basedpyright error outside the baseline makes `uv run basedpyright` exit non-zero.

## Approach

Run `uv run basedpyright --writebaseline`, then `git add .basedpyright/baseline.json`. Confirm the file has no `orchestra/` entry and that `uv run basedpyright` exits 0. Confirm a temporary `x: int = "a"` file under `orchestra/` makes the command fail, then delete the file.
